title: Claude Code Hooks: Auto-Approve Tools, Get Notifications, and Run Linters
summary: Claude Code hooks run shell commands at key moments — auto-approve safe tools, send desktop notifications, run Prettier on save. Complete 2026 guide with 5 ready-to-paste recipes.
body_markdown: Claude Code injects tool-specific variables into every hook process.` CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH` holds the file path for` Write` and` Read` operations.` CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND` holds the command string for` Bash` operations. Inside` Stop` hooks,` stop_hook_active` is set to` true` — check this variable to prevent infinite loops where the hook triggers another stop.
